description: Pushes a text-step workout guide (one step per exercise, advanced by a lap press) to the user's Suunto account via the SuuntoPlus Guide Cloud API. Needs SUUNTO_APP_NAME to exactly match the app name registered on apizone.suunto.com. No live push: it appears after the phone's next Suunto app sync. For gym sessions prefer push_strength_guide. Returns Suunto's response (guide id) plus check { verified, note? }: verified:false means the guide was not found in the guide list after the push; say so instead of reporting success. Queued one at a time. Write operation.

guideId.description: Updates this existing guide instead of creating a new one.

title.description: Session name shown in the Suunto app.

name: push_workout_guide
title: Push workout guide to watch
